title: A procedural generation library with citations for every technique. Here's an island I made with it.
author: BlaiseLabs
selftext:
A couple game devs in [r/proceduralgeneration](https://www.reddit.com/r/proceduralgeneration/) mentioned this library was helpful in the [original post](https://www.reddit.com/r/proceduralgeneration/s/W41QZd2LMs), so I figured I'd share here as well.

Procedural-almanac is a library of procedural generation functions in vanilla JavaScript with no dependencies. Every function is pure so the code can be ported into any coding language or gaming engine without much effort. It also works in the browser or with Node. The library includes a catalog of citations for every technique used.

GH repo: [procedural-almanac](http://github.com/BlaiseLabs/procedural-almanac)

Demo: [Random Island Generator](https://blaiselabs.github.io/procedural-almanac/examples/island/)
